## Projects

- [LinkLens — Enterprise Link Intelligence Platform](https://mahbub.dev/projects/linklens/): Enterprise-grade smart link and redirect intelligence platform with sub-5ms Redis hot-path routing, ClickHouse forensic analytics, QR generation, RBAC workspaces, webhooks, and self-hosted zero-cost geo/device intelligence. _(NestJS, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, Prisma, Docker)_
- [Bangla & English ASR Studio](https://mahbub.dev/projects/bangla-and-english-asr-studio/): End-to-end speech recognition studio for Bangla and English with Whisper inference, live microphone transcription, batch processing, WER/CER benchmarking, dataset validation, and LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning workflows for GPU training clusters. _(Python, Whisper, faster-whisper, Gradio, Transformers, LoRA, Audio Processing, ML Evaluation)_
- [Local Vocal Agent](https://mahbub.dev/projects/local-vocal-agent/): Privacy-first local AI voice workspace with FastAPI, React/Vite, Ollama, SQLite and Chroma memory, Faster Whisper STT, TTS, streaming chat, search tools, file workspace, and permission-aware assistant workflows. _(FastAPI, React, Ollama, SQLite, ChromaDB, Whisper, TTS, RAG)_
- [Advanced Finance Tracker](https://mahbub.dev/projects/advanced-finance-tracker/): Production-grade offline-first finance platform with Expo React Native, local SQLite storage, typed money utilities, budgeting, transactions, accounts, goals, recurring flows, analytics, AI insight planning, and a NestJS API foundation. _(React Native, Expo, TypeScript, SQLite, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Jest)_
- [Healthcare & Medical Applications](https://mahbub.dev/projects/healthcare-and-medical-applications/): Production-focused healthcare and medical application modules including multi-role workflows, dashboards, secure access, reporting, and payment-related integrations. _(React.js, Node.js, Laravel, MySQL, MongoDB)_
- [Enterprise & School Management Systems](https://mahbub.dev/projects/enterprise-and-school-management-systems/): Academic and enterprise management modules covering student, faculty, administrative, reporting, and business workflow features. _(Laravel, React.js, Node.js, MySQL)_
- [Real-Time Chat Application](https://mahbub.dev/projects/real-time-chat-application/): Real-time chat application with instant messaging, modern UI, and socket-based communication between users. _(React.js, Node.js, Socket.io, CSS)_
- [React Portfolio](https://mahbub.dev/projects/react-portfolio/): Personal portfolio built with React/Next.js, responsive UI, SEO metadata, server-rendered sections, and admin-managed content. _(Next.js, React.js, CSS, MongoDB)_
- [Test-Buddy](https://mahbub.dev/projects/test-buddy/): React-based test and exam management demo application built for a university software engineering course. _(React.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript)_
- [Blood Donation Management System](https://mahbub.dev/projects/blood-donation-management-system/): Java desktop application for managing blood donor records, blood bank information, and request tracking with SQLite storage. _(Java, SQLite, Java Swing)_
